_comment: Default catalog order = estimated real-world usage popularity, most-used first. Tiers: ranks 1-18 ubiquitous commercial product languages (SaaS, OS and device-maker design systems, dev-tool defaults); 19-40 mainstream modern effects plus editorial workhorses; 41-60 terminal/retro-computing and internet-nostalgia waves with mass recognition; 61-78 type-led, sci-fi and brutalist-family scenes; 79-91 maximalist and illustration-led scenes; 92-120 craft, texture and internet-subculture niches with the least commercial deployment. Owner override: hype tier (Apple Liquid Glass, Bento Grid, Glassmorphism, Neo-Brutalism, Brutalism, Aurora Glow, Y2K, Claymorphism) promoted to ranks 3-10. Signals: design-system distribution (Material, Fluent, Liquid Glass, Carbon, Polaris), most-copied product aesthetics (Stripe, Linear, Notion, Geist), 2024-2026 trend roundups, OS-level diffusion. Re-rank by reordering 'order' and bumping 'updated'. validate.mjs enforces 1:1 coverage with designs/.
method: Curated static ranking; update by editing 'order' in this file only.
